**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a vegetarian salad. It has an arugula base topped with roasted or grilled eggplant, asparagus spears, raw tofu cubes and a little radicchio. The leaves look lightly dressed.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** It is a large square white dinner plate, about 27 cm per side. Because the plate is square, I used side × side instead of the circle formula: about 27 × 27 ≈ 700 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Arugula
- Roasted eggplant (oily)
- Asparagus
- Tofu cubes
- Radicchio bits
- Oil/vinaigrette dressing

**STEP 4 - Area:** Food covers about 55% of the plate.

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Arugula | 30% | 210 cm² |
| Eggplant | 12% | 84 cm² |
| Asparagus | 6% | 42 cm² |
| Tofu | 6% | 42 cm² |
| Radicchio | 1% | 7 cm² |
| **Total** | **55%** | |

**STEP 5–6 - Volume and grams:**

| Item | Area × height | Volume | Density | Grams |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Arugula | 210 × 3 cm | 630 ml | 0.13 | ≈ 82 g |
| Eggplant | 84 × 2 cm | 168 ml | 0.6 | ≈ 100 g |
| Asparagus | 42 × 1.2 cm | 50 ml | 0.7 | ≈ 35 g |
| Tofu | 42 × 2.5 cm | 105 ml | 0.9 | ≈ 95 g |
| Radicchio | 7 × 1 cm | 7 ml | 0.7 | ≈ 5 g |
| Dressing/oil | estimated directly | | | ≈ 8 g |

The tofu weight matches a second check: there are about 6 cubes of roughly 15 g each.

**STEP 7 - Energy:**

| Item | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Arugula | 82 | 25 | 21 |
| Eggplant (roasted with oil) | 100 | 110 | 110 |
| Asparagus | 35 | 30 | 11 |
| Tofu | 95 | 100 | 95 |
| Radicchio | 5 | 23 | 1 |
| Dressing/oil | 8 | 600 | 48 |
| **Total** | **325 g** | | **≈ 286 kcal** |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 325 g and 290 kcal is plausible for a light salad on a half-covered large plate.
